description.fallback: Naruto and Shikamaru watch the announcement of the new Parent and Child Day holiday. The two discuss how the shinobi life has changed since their days. Shikamaru intends to free Naruto's schedule so he can spend it with his children, but several shopkeepers arrive at his office, needing his signature on several forms.
